rules.description: Standard maximum threshold of 0.1% deleted records for Eurostat BMI data refreshes
Asserts active BMI StatVars have data through at least 2019 and historical EU28/ISCED97 series retain their expected latest year

params.condition: CASE WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, 'EU28') THEN MaxDate >= '2014' WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, 'PrePrimaryEducation|TertiaryEducationStageOne') THEN MaxDate >= '2008' ELSE MaxDate >= '2019' END
